context_files.purpose: Verbatim directive to continue ordinary scouts while parking the full C11 guard.
Corrected self-contained protocol, authority, workload, gates, claim, and lifecycle.
Canonical requested and forbidden implementation authority.
Adjudicated v2 rework consensus whose six accepted concerns this successor disposes.
Terminal broad-habit result motivating a multi-key selective-binding test.

system_thesis_interpretation: The proposed gateway preserves the THINK-DREAM-SLEEP thesis only as a deliberately narrow necessary-capability scout. THINK contributes two child-authored source actions around a public outcome; the fixed DREAM derivative discards the initial action and outcome and retains visible tool, visible mode, a neutral endpoint frame, and the exact successful final ACT; SLEEP writes that endpoint target with a target-masked LoRA. Correctness-selected admission means a pass would establish carriage of already achieved actions on seen keys, not autonomous credit assignment, outcome-token causality, reasoning-path learning, generalization, retention, writer qualification, parenting readiness, C11 readiness, or an end-to-end organism. This scientific boundary is sound and the implementation-only authority split is explicit. The current bytes nevertheless need rework before implementation ratification because the post-commit visibility matrix contradicts the explicit-map oracle and several decision-changing reducers remain non-total or underspecified.
graph_delta_interpretation: Each engineered root has 24 preassigned tools split 12/12 across orientation strata, 48 candidate tool-mode keys, eight paired source opportunities per key and mirror world, four selected tools per stratum, sixteen selected keys, and 32 retained endpoints per world. Each adapter therefore has 128 rows and the four fits total 512 items. The two orientation strata prevent a single global mode-to-action shortcut, and the W+/W- row complement makes adapter identity a wrong-map control under matched nuisance geometry. The two roots are identity-, case-, surface-, and RNG-disjoint robustness roots, not population-independent samples, because they share the base model, tokenizer family, recipe, algorithms, grammar, and thresholds. Concrete opaque identifiers, seed values, tokenizer receipts, renderer bytes, and request serialization can legitimately remain for the separately ratified execution manifest, provided that manifest binds canonical byte identities, seed namespaces and derivation, condition-sharing for common-random replicates, discovery-independent ordering, and every tokenizer-dependent equality before the first source call. The graph is not visibility-consistent as written: hidden_mapping_and_admission is derived_only at post_commit_evaluate with the explanation that only the scorer uses the map after generation, while the explicit-map oracle necessarily places an explicit map in frozen-base model-visible prompt bytes at that same stage. The map, admission bits, oracle-rendered map copy, generator, and scorer need separate objects and post-commit principals or substages.
loop_delta_interpretation: The intended execution loop is appropriately one-way and result-blind: freeze geometry and symbolic workload; acquire every predeclared paired source opportunity without semantic retry or replacement; select lowest eligible ordinals only after a root's candidate source closes; compile the fixed target-masked derivative; verify the matched complement bijection; fit four isolated adapters under later authority; require all four commits before any held or oracle load; evaluate; reduce roots separately; and never use a failed root, best adapter, changed dose, or replacement to rescue the run. The implementation grant does not authorize running CPU tests, loading a tokenizer/model/trainer, creating adapters, using a device, launching source, or touching parenting, lineage, C11, release, or claims before exact human ratification; model execution additionally requires a later immutable manifest, dual PASS review, and separate ratification. The simple fail-if-exists, realpath/symlink, no-overwrite, persistent stage markers, immutable hashes, and narrow capability sentinels are proportionate to the directive and resolve the requested scout-level capability boundary without importing a C11 sandbox. The terminal state machine is not yet total, however. A source failure requires an immediate stop before fitting, a failed or exhausted infrastructure retry can leave fewer than four COMMITTED adapters, and a hash/receipt failure can stop before held evaluation; none of those cases yields both members of the mandated ordered root-label pair. The proposal must distinguish a pre-evaluation run failure from a completed two-root scientific reduction, or specify exact independent stage scheduling and terminal placeholders without violating the stop-on-failure rule.
claim_delta_interpretation: The replacement wording correctly says that both engineered-disjoint roots share one frozen model and recipe, reports the aggregate and stratum gates, states the 12-of-16 and 6-of-8 directional requirement rather than implying every key passed, and confines spill evidence to four bound families. Even a valid two-root pass would show mapping-specific, single-action behavior only on correctness-selected seen keys and held renderings. It would not show unseen-key composition, outcome necessity, natural credit assignment, semantic independence of surfaces, general non-harm, statistical replication, retention, qualification, parenting, C11, or publication readiness. No present claim exists because v1, v2, and v3 are NOT_RUN/proposal-only. The permitted reading remains unavailable until the visibility contradiction and exact reducer semantics are repaired, all prospective gates pass under later authority, and claim-specific governance is satisfied.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The source-child/trusted-compile/train/post-commit split captures most of the required information cut. The child may see only the public conversation; the outcome harness alone may use the hidden map to emit the bit; the eligibility reducer may use parsed final actions plus the map only after source closure; the compiler may verify provenance but must serialize only visible state and the exact child target; and the trainer must exclude initial action, outcome, map, correctness, admission, case identity, and held bytes. Requiring held/oracle material to remain unloadable until all four adapters commit is the correct noninterference barrier, and T02 should test model-visible serialization, labels/masks, logs, exceptions, caches, filenames, receipts, and retry inputs rather than only field omission. But the matrix cannot simultaneously declare hidden_mapping_and_admission derived_only at post_commit_evaluate and run an explicit-map oracle whose model prompt directly contains the map. A broad visible permission would overgrant the primary, spill, and adapter panels, while derived_only makes the oracle impossible. Split hidden mapping from admission, create a separately hash-bound oracle-rendered-map object, and split post-commit evaluation into oracle generator, ordinary generator, and scorer principals with exact direct/derived/forbidden access. Also define the ASCII-whitespace canonicalizer byte-for-byte; naming canonicalization without its input alphabet and rewrite rule does not make registry separation deterministic.
acceptance_test_interpretation: The frozen cardinalities and symbolic workload in T01 are arithmetically closed: across two roots source is 1,536 trajectories, 3,072 emissions, and 49,152 output tokens; training is four fits, 512 items, and at most 262,144 token-passes; primary is 768 emissions and 12,288 output tokens; oracle is 256 and 4,096; spill generation is 768 and 12,288; interface is at most 192 and 24,576; and teacher-forced binding plus spill is 1,536 candidate sequence scores. Thus the generation total is 5,056 emissions and 102,400 new tokens. The later manifest must still bind the finite load schedule, batching, exact input/scored-token totals, timeout and identical-byte retry maxima, throughput evidence, and cumulative projection before source; measured source cost cannot be erased. T02 has the right mutation surface but cannot pass against the current visibility matrix because oracle map visibility contradicts derived_only map access. T03 now fixes two emissions, continuing-session authorship, no semantic retry, lowest integer ordinals, and no replacement. T04 fixes the complement row bijection and makes equal complete-target token lengths a pre-source tokenizer condition. T05 is not yet an exact parser/interface oracle: line splitting, CR/LF treatment, the definition of a purported marker, transport truncation metadata, source-specific DONE rejection, and which OFF/W+/W-/oracle/spill/interface conditions are covered by any generated turn and required interface task remain ambiguous. In particular, requiring every one of the 24 interface condition-tasks to contain an action would make OFF behavior a pass prerequisite unless the required subset is explicitly identified. T06 repairs the formerly unreachable BINDING_WITH_SPILL label and correctly uses exhaustive tool-cluster resampling, but exact results still depend on whether per-key NLL reduction is a median of paired reductions or a difference of medians, how the even four-form median is defined, which observations feed the adapter-pair mean difference, whether that difference is absolute, how per-prompt spill TVs become one family statistic, and the numeric accumulation/rounding/serialization convention. Missing pre-commit artifacts also have no run-level terminal representation. T07 appropriately tests scout-level lifecycle and forbidden capability hooks, but its partial-stage fixtures expose the missing terminal contract rather than resolving it. T08 must return rework, not PASS, until those semantic issues are bound on revised identical bytes. Relative to the six accepted V2 concerns, clustered uncertainty, complete symbolic workload with pre-source accounting, and the narrow CPU capability boundary are resolved; source protocol and matched geometry are substantially resolved; label reachability is repaired but terminal reduction is not total; and parser/scoring plus post-commit visibility remain only partially resolved.
assumptions: The exact_scope.md protocol is the normative detailed expansion of architecture_change.json, while scope_proposal.json is the closed authority list; no prose in this interpretation grants implementation or execution authority.

Concrete run identifiers, rendered prompt bytes, seed integers, tokenizer outputs, dependency and hardware identities, batching, timeouts, and retry maxima are intentionally deferred to a later immutable execution manifest and must be fixed and reviewed before any tokenizer or model call.
The two retained case ordinals for a selected key identify paired but separate W+ and W- source conversations and induce the deterministic mirror-row bijection after provenance verification.
The four teacher-forced forms for a key are the h values in q_z(k), and both modes of a resampled tool carry all of their form-level observations together in the exhaustive cluster reducer.
Inequalities are literal: equality passes the 0.05 spill ceilings, the 0.25 adapter-pair NLL-difference ceiling, and every >= gate, while the lower stability bound must be strictly greater than zero.
Invalid, missing, truncated, flooded, and transport-error generations are preserved in their declared fixed denominator and cannot be silently dropped, retried semantically, or replaced.
The requested lifecycle is intentionally simple scout hygiene; this interpretation does not require a transitive C11-grade sandbox, generalized security proof, or final-run durability machinery.

ambiguities.question: Is each key's optimization statistic the median of four paired values NLL_OFF(h,target)-NLL_adapter(h,target), a difference between two four-form medians, or another reduction; how is the even-sample median defined; and is the adapter-pair mean comparison an absolute difference over key medians or over all form-level values?
ambiguities.impact: The same finite likelihood table can cross the 0.50-nat per-key gate or 0.25-nat pair-symmetry gate under different conventional implementations, changing OPTIMIZATION_INCONCLUSIVE and every later label.

ambiguities.question: Is a spill family's conditional-action TV the arithmetic mean of prompt-level adapter-versus-OFF TVs, a TV after pooling conditional distributions, a maximum, or another statistic; and exactly which panels and conditions are covered by any generated turn in the structural flood gate?
ambiguities.impact: Different reductions change the 0.05 spill decision, while a multi-ACT oracle or OFF emission may or may not preempt BINDING_WITH_SPILL as INTERFACE_OR_FLOOD_INVALID.

ambiguities.question: Which of the 24 interface condition-task pairs are required to emit at least one action, what map or objective makes an action correct for W+, W-, and OFF, and is ACT followed by DONE in one emission a valid one-action termination?
ambiguities.impact: If all OFF tasks are required to act, a base-model control becomes a structural prerequisite; if only fitted own-map tasks are required, the current universal wording overstates the gate. Implementations can therefore assign different interface labels to identical transcripts.

ambiguities.question: What exact byte algorithm splits lines, treats LF versus CRLF and other ASCII controls, identifies an unrecognized or purported ACT marker, consumes transport truncation metadata, and canonicalizes ASCII whitespace for cross-family registry comparison?
ambiguities.impact: Parser validity, source admission, flood precedence, held-surface collision checks, and T05 fault fixtures are not byte-deterministic until one grammar and canonicalizer are frozen.

ambiguities.question: What dtype, token-log-probability extraction precision, canonical form/key accumulation order, summation algorithm, stable-log-sum-exp implementation, threshold comparison precision, and JSON encoding govern q, I, NLL, BA, tau, g, TV, and the 65,536 resampled means?
ambiguities.impact: Lexicographic resample enumeration fixes membership but not floating reduction bytes; near-threshold fixtures and promised byte-deterministic results can diverge across compliant runtimes.

ambiguities.question: What exact run artifact and root status are emitted when one source root fails before fitting, a fit exhausts its infrastructure replay, a hash or receipt fails, or fewer than four adapters commit, given the immediate stop rule and the requirement to record an ordered pair of seven scientific root labels?
ambiguities.impact: The lifecycle can fail closed, but it cannot always produce the mandated ordered reduction; restart, reporting, and reviewer expectations differ depending on whether a missing root is FAILED, NOT_EVALUATED, or absent.

ambiguities.question: Will the later manifest bind a collision-checked canonical namespace for root/tool/case/form/prompt/task/request identifiers and a domain-separated seed derivation showing root disjointness, W+/W- matched training randomness, condition-common evaluation replicates, and identical-byte retry equality?
ambiguities.impact: Deferral is appropriate under the V2 scope split, but model execution is not reproducible or reviewable unless every identity, sharing relation, and RNG consumer is closed before source.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The post-commit visibility matrix is incompatible with the required explicit-map oracle.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: hidden_mapping_and_admission is derived_only at post_commit_evaluate and its reason permits map use only by the scorer after generation. The explicit-map oracle instead requires an exact map to be rendered into a frozen-base prompt before that oracle generation. held_and_oracle_material being visible does not resolve the conflict because it contains a direct model-visible copy of the same hidden map, while admission must remain unavailable and ordinary held panels must not receive the map.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Split hidden map, admission, and oracle-rendered map into distinct information objects; split post-commit evaluation into ordinary generator, explicit-map oracle generator, and scorer/reducer principals or stages; permit the oracle-rendered map only to the oracle generator after four commits; permit sealed-map scoring only to the reducer; and keep admission and map bytes forbidden from every other generator. Regenerate the complete Cartesian matrix and T02 mutations.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal still does not define a unique optimization and spill result for every finite score table.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The median own-map NLL reduction does not choose median-of-paired-differences versus difference-of-medians or define the even median. The adapter-pair mean difference lacks its observation level and absolute/signed convention. Spill TV does not define how prompt-level TVs aggregate within a family. Numeric precision, ordered accumulation, and threshold serialization are also unbound even though T06 promises byte determinism. These are estimator semantics that the V2 consensus required before implementation, not concrete run bytes that can silently be chosen later.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Give equations over indexed form-level likelihoods for every NLL statistic and the family TV statistic; define the four-value median, absolute/signed pair comparison, missing/non-finite propagation, dtype, canonical accumulation and sorting order, stable log-sum-exp, threshold comparison precision, and result serialization. Add fixtures where alternative conventional definitions straddle each threshold.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The strict parser examples do not yet define one byte-total parser/controller or identify the exact interface conditions whose action presence is mandatory.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Exact full line leaves line-ending and control handling open; purported marker and truncation-before-valid-ACT require definitions over raw bytes plus transport metadata; source rejects every DONE-containing emission while the general grammar permits DONE after ACT; and any generated turn plus any required interface task do not identify the relevant panel/condition set. In particular, 24 interface tasks include OFF, W+, and W-, but the proposal does not say whether OFF must act or which fitted condition is judged against which map.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Specify a total raw-byte-plus-transport parser with exact LF/CR/control, marker-prefix, source override, truncation, multiple-line, and ACT/DONE state rules. Enumerate the generated panels subject to the global multi-ACT structural gate and the exact interface task-condition pairs subject to action-presence and correctness requirements, including termination semantics. Make T05 exhaust this finite contract.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The ordered two-root reducer cannot represent every fail-closed lifecycle allowed by the proposal.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A SOURCE_INVALID root stops the run before four fits; an exhausted fit retry, partial commit, hash mismatch, lifecycle violation, or receipt failure stops before held material can open. The seven root labels describe source or completed scientific reductions and contain no NOT_EVALUATED or EXECUTION_FAILED value, yet section 10 says the run artifact records an ordered pair. Continuing the other root to manufacture the pair can violate the stop condition, while assigning ASSAY_INVALID to an uncommitted adapter would misclassify infrastructure as evidence.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define a separate exhaustive run-lifecycle terminal vocabulary and artifact for pre-evaluation failures, with ordered per-root status values such as NOT_STARTED, SOURCE_INVALID, FIT_FAILED, COMMITTED, and NOT_EVALUATED. Produce the seven-label pair only after both roots have the artifacts required by that reducer, or explicitly define placeholders and stage scheduling. Bind all cases in T06/T07 and keep lifecycle failures outside scientific negative evidence.

open_questions: Will Rohin require newly hash-bound proposal bytes that resolve MWG3_SYS_D01 through MWG3_SYS_D04 before any exact implementation ratification?
Will the corrected matrix explicitly isolate oracle-rendered map visibility from ordinary generation, scoring, admission, source, compilation, and training access?

Will exact NLL, spill-TV, parser, interface-condition, numeric, and lifecycle terminal semantics be fixed as architecture now while only concrete identifiers, seeds, tokenizer receipts, prompt bytes, batching, timeouts, and throughput remain deferred to the later execution manifest?

Will any eventual approval remain limited to the four requested implementation-scope entries, with model/tokenizer execution, CPU test execution before approval, training, adapter creation, GPU use, parenting, lineage mutation, C11, claim, release, and submission still requiring their stated later authorities?
